delivery_strategy.rule: Do not block a platform release because another platform is incomplete. Release a platform or a clearly labeled date-range tranche when its own validation gates pass.
delivery_strategy.tranche_policy: Publish validated yearly or monthly tranches with explicit coverage and unresolved-date counts; do not label a partial tranche as a complete historical database.
delivery_strategy.auxiliary_platform_first: Magnum is the first auxiliary development candidate after/alongside Grand Dragon because its historical archive has the strongest disclosed cross-check coverage. Sports Toto and Da Ma Cai continue independently; do not wait for one another.

source_policy.lineage_rule: Websites that mirror the same upstream feed count as one source lineage, not independent corroboration.
source_policy.conflict_rule: Never silently overwrite. Preserve each candidate and resolve field-by-field; unresolved conflicts remain quarantined.
source_policy.missing_data_rule: Never invent or statistically fill winning numbers. Keep unknown dates/fields explicitly missing until evidence is found.

manual_import.required_evidence: A source URL, archived page, screenshot, scan, or other retrievable evidence reference must accompany each manually transcribed draw.
manual_import.promotion_rule: Only structurally valid, provenance-complete records with no unresolved conflict may be promoted to the operator's canonical CSV. Any record that cannot be independently cross-checked remains unverified and quarantined; do not infer missing numbers.

validation_gates.structural: All 23 winning numbers must be present and four digits; leading zeroes must be preserved.
validation_gates.date: Draw date must fall within that operator's configured historical target. Do not assume every calendar day is a draw day; use operator-specific schedules and special-draw evidence.
validation_gates.duplicate: Check operator_id + draw_date and, when available, draw_seq. Same-date candidates with differing numbers require conflict review.
validation_gates.provenance: Every imported row must retain source lineage and evidence reference in an audit/staging record.
validation_gates.normalization: Canonical output must contain prize_1..3, special_1..10, consolation_1..10 and must be independently readable by that operator's model.
validation_gates.release: A platform may be developed/released independently once its declared tranche passes structural, provenance, duplicate, conflict, and model-read tests. Full-history completion requires all dates in its declared historical scope to be accounted for.

grand_dragon.evidence: Lists Grand Dragon on-record since 2020-04-11; draw-night source gdlotto.com; 101 draws since 2021 checked against the operator archive; remaining older records mainly check4d.org only.
grand_dragon.assessment: Its API archive was probed successfully from 2020-04-11 onward, but this is not the operator's proven inception date. A separate GD-filtered number-history source suggests a 2019 hit; 2016-2018 remains unresolved.

grand_dragon.evidence: Discloses Grand Dragon uses trusted-community 4DMoon feed; its Verified label means its own checks passed against that approved feed.
grand_dragon.assessment: Useful secondary source, but do not count as independent of 4DMoon lineage.

grand_dragon.evidence: Current operator-specific page reports 855 distinct draw dates from 2024-07-02 through 2026-11-03. The 2026-11-03 date page lists draw 3612/2026 and all 23 prize numbers; its full board matches the staged 2026-11-03 candidate.
grand_dragon.assessment: High-priority full-draw cross-check source. The 855-date archive still requires date-by-date and 23-field comparison against the canonical Grand Dragon CSV; do not promote records solely from the archive's own source claim.

grand_dragon.evidence: Lists 35 draws from 2026-09-25 to 2026-11-01, with top-three prizes and draw numbers.
grand_dragon.assessment: Recent top-prize cross-check only unless detail pages expose all 23 numbers.

grand_dragon.evidence: Lists 122 Grand Dragon 4D draws from 2026-07-01 to 2026-10-30 with draw IDs and top-three numbers.
grand_dragon.assessment: Recent date/Draw ID cross-check; inspect detail pages for full tiers.

grand_dragon.evidence: Searchable Cambodia date pages expose complete 23-number Grand Dragon results, including 2020-09-09 and 2022-01-02/02-05/03-02/03-06/04-02/04-03/04-06. The 2022-04-02, 2022-04-03 and 2022-04-06 full boards match corresponding 4D2ULive pages and have been staged as candidates.
grand_dragon.assessment: Historical recovery source. Some older records may share lineage with 4D Live Today, which discloses Check4D as an upstream source. Treat matching pages as corroboration evidence only; these three staged 2022 candidates remain unverified until source lineage independence is established.

grand_dragon.evidence: Historical 2020 page shows Grand Dragon 4D with First/Second/Third and full Special/Consolation lists.
grand_dragon.assessment: Potential additional archive; independence from Check4D and 4DMoon not yet established.

grand_dragon.evidence: Current Grand Dragon daily feed shows all 23 numbers and recent draw history.
grand_dragon.assessment: Recent full-tier cross-check candidate; older archive depth not yet established.

grand_dragon.evidence: Date-specific and paginated Cambodia archives expose full 23-number Grand Dragon draws in 2020 (including 2020-07-03, 2020-08-04, 2020-09-11, 2020-09-21, 2020-10-22 and December 2020) and 2022 (2022-03-04, 2022-04-02, 2022-04-03, 2022-04-06). Its 2026-11-03 page also displays the full 23-number draw 3612/2026. The 2022-04-02/03/06 boards match Check4D field-for-field.
grand_dragon.assessment: High-priority historical recovery archive. Upstream lineage relative to Check4D and 4D Live Today is not proven. The three matching 2022-04 candidates remain staged as unverified and must not be promoted solely because two websites display the same board.

grand_dragon.evidence: Operator-filtered number history for 3313 shows Grand Dragon hits from 2020-03-03 onward. Its 9411 page has 2016 hits, but those rows are labelled as other operators (Magnum/Sandakan/Singapore), not Grand Dragon; operator identity must be read from the icon.
grand_dragon.assessment: Can corroborate individual number/date/prize and operator identity only; must not mistake other operators' 2016 hits for Grand Dragon draws.

grand_dragon.evidence: Grand Dragon-filtered number history lists prize category, draw ID and date for number 3313.
grand_dragon.assessment: Useful Draw ID and individual-hit cross-check, not a full-draw source.

grand_dragon.evidence: GD-filtered number history lists 3313 as a Grand Dragon Special hit on 2019-01-21 (draw 766/2019), plus 2020 and later hits. This is an individual-number hit only, not a full draw.
grand_dragon.assessment: Unresolved single-number lead. The GD4D number-history page for 3313 lists Grand Dragon hits from 2020-03-03 onward and does not show 2019-01-21; the 4D Huat number-history page also does not show a 2019 Grand Dragon hit. The sources may have different coverage, so this is not a confirmed contradiction or a proven inception date. Do not infer a full 23-number draw; seek the original draw page or another date-specific source.

grand_dragon.evidence: The operator's official Past Results page provides a date selector and the full 4D prize board. Direct automated access returned HTTP 403 during this audit, so no historical records were extracted from it.
grand_dragon.assessment: Highest-priority authoritative source for date-by-date recovery. Direct access is currently blocked; do not infer any missing result from the public page shell.

grand_dragon.evidence: The operator states that approved tech partners can obtain full access to all results history from day one through its result API.
grand_dragon.assessment: Potentially the strongest recovery route for 2016-2021 and any dates absent from public mirrors. Access requires operator approval/credentials; availability and historical start date must be confirmed with GDLotto.

grand_dragon.source: GDLotto Official Result Feed API announcement
grand_dragon.evidence: Official blog announcement dated 2017-12-30 says GDLotto launched a result-feed API for live 4D positions A-W.
grand_dragon.assessment: Earliest official operational/API evidence found in this audit. It proves the API existed by 2017-12-30, not that the operator began then; it does not establish whether 2016 draws existed.

grand_dragon.source: 4D 万字迷 (Like4D) Grand Dragon Results archive
grand_dragon.evidence: The archive page contains full 23-prize boards and draw IDs 144/2017 through 153/2017 for 2017-05-25 to 2017-06-03. Ten date-specific rows were manually transcribed into data/manual_import/grand_dragon_candidates_2017-05-25_to_2017-06-03_like4d.csv; all 23 numbers per row are structurally complete.
grand_dragon.assessment: Single third-party publisher only. No independent full-board second source or upstream lineage proof has yet been established. All ten staged rows remain unverified and quarantined; do not promote them to canonical data or training.

magnum.evidence: Reports Magnum history since 1985 and says all 6,817 draws in its archive agree between Magnum official archive and check4d.org as of 2026-10-02.
magnum.assessment: Strongest current auxiliary-platform candidate for the 2006-present target; independently corroborated per provider disclosure.

magnum.evidence: Publishes all 23 prize fields and exposes year/month archive navigation back to 1985; discloses upstream data from 4dlivetoday.com.
magnum.assessment: Convenient manual/source mirror; same lineage as 4D Live Today, not independent.

sportstoto.evidence: Reports older Sports Toto records from check4d.org and 4dmoon archives agreeing; explicitly identifies missing periods in 2008 and 2009 (49 and 84 draws on record versus about 157 in a normal year).
sportstoto.assessment: Strong source for backfill, but known historical gaps must remain explicit.

damacai.evidence: Reports 414 Da Ma Cai draws since 2005 checked against the official archive; remaining older records are mainly from check4d.org only.
damacai.assessment: Useful broad archive; older rows have weaker corroboration than Magnum.

damacai.evidence: Publishes full 23-number result rows and year/month archive navigation; discloses upstream data from 4dlivetoday.com.
damacai.assessment: Convenient mirror; same lineage as 4D Live Today.
